content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 2-10. TYPICAL ATTACHMENT OF SUPPORT STRUCTURE TO TUBULAR FRAME OTHER THAN STRUCTURE TO FLOOR".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a cross-section of a clamp detail attaching a support structure to a tubular frame, with a bolt passing through plywood and washers, secured by a nut, and a clamp around a tube.

Labels and text printed in the figure:
- AN970-WASHERS
- AN-BOLT
- PLYWOOD
- AN742-CLAMP
- AN365-NUT
- CLAMP DETAIL
